body:
Run record for the re-run #23992 asks for, after the item's stale revoke oracle was re-pointed (step 4 and acceptance[2]: `401` → `403` with `error.code` `API_KEY_REVOKED` and no rows). Runner: an `os-dev` subagent dispatched by the `domain:devx` seat 2 PM (session `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`). Protocol: `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Executed sequentially (no subagent tool in this runner).

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `e1e711ae259c785a4b87009a0576a64546ee8764`, the tip of branch `claude/issue-23992-api-key-ui-revoke-oracle` at run time. Its product tree is `origin/main` `e18b23fac`; the branch changes `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json` only. Built with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75 tasks green).
- `.objectui-sha`: `f8267df93aba8fb09cc1cc0692eadc0c8c5a5e56`. The console was built from that pin by `pnpm objectui:build` in this tree; `pnpm check:console-sha` reads "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@f8267df93aba)".
- host: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 41873 -d file:(run dir)/data.db` from `examples/app-showcase`, with `OS_PORT=41873`. Fresh DB, seeded admin.
- browser: Playwright through `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` (Chromium 141.0.7390.37), headless, one browser context per persona.
- personas: the seeded admin (platform admin); two members minted by invite + sign-up (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email`), the key owner and a second member; a second pair minted the same way for the two-owner scoping leg.
- timestamps: 2026-10-16, 18:28Z to 18:32Z.

## Scope

Selector `identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle` resolves to 1 runnable item: `identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle` at revision 2, P1, surface mixed. Revision 2 is the revision #23992's branch carries. The item has no `automated.ref`, so every clause was driven (Tier 2).

## Per-clause verdicts

| item | # | clause (short) | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 0 | secret shown exactly once | pass | `POST /api/v1/keys` (owner) 201 with `data` keys `id, name, prefix, key, active_organization_id, expires_at`, raw `key` 47 chars; owner `GET /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/KEY_ID` 200 with no `key` field (`prefix` `osk_qJhGmHRe`); admin get-by-id 200, no `key` field; the owner's `user_id`-filtered list 200, 1 row, raw value absent; console: Generate key on the Integrations page answered 201, the dialog showed the raw value, and after Done the raw value is absent from the page |
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 1 | key authenticates as its owner, not a superuser | pass | `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task` with `x-api-key` 200, 10 rows; the owner's session read 200, 10 rows, identical id set. Discriminating object `showcase_inquiry`: admin 3 rows, owner session 0, owner key 200 with 0 |
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 2 | revoke immediate, server-side, 403 `API_KEY_REVOKED` | pass | owner `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/KEY_ID {"revoked": true}` 200 (row reads back `revoked: true`); the very next `x-api-key` read 403, body `{"error": {"code": "API_KEY_REVOKED", "message": …}}`, no rows; repeated: same. Through the console row action Revoke API Key (confirm "Revoke this API key? …" → Continue): the request was `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/KEY_ID` body `{"revoked":true}`, 200; the next two `x-api-key` reads 403 `API_KEY_REVOKED`, no rows. Control: an unrecognised `osk_` key 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`. The message's wording was not scored |
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 3 | restore reversible (200) | pass | owner `PATCH … {"revoked": false}` 200; next `x-api-key` read 200, 10 rows, same id set as the session read. Through the console row action Restore API Key: `PATCH` body `{"revoked":false}` 200; next read 200, 10 rows |
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 4 | mine-view scoped; admin all_keys shows every user's | pass | the second member: `user_id`-filtered (mine) list 200, 0 rows, owner key absent; unfiltered list 200, owner key absent; get-by-id of the owner key 404. Two-owner leg: each member's mine list holds its own key and not the other's; the admin's list 200, 3 keys across 3 owners, both included. Console: the member's app list is `showcase_app`, `account` (no Setup); Setup → API Keys (`all_keys`) as admin lists 4 keys across 3 owners |
| identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle | 5 | dialog and list render (screenshot) | pass | dialog: title "Your new API key", "Copy this now — for your security it will not be shown again.", the secret in a monospace field beside a Copy button, Done. The re-opened list (account app, My Keys, `mine` view) shows name + prefix rows (`osk_c1auWsef`, `osk_qJhGmHRe`), no secret; request `GET /api/v1/data/sys_api_key` 200 |

Negatives: none hit. No raw secret on any second read (list, get-by-id, re-opened page); no revoked key answered 200 or served a row; no post-revoke refusal was a generic 401 or carried another code; the key read no more than its owner's session; no key appeared in another member's mine view.

Traps ruled out: `wrong-persona` (the key owner and the second member are plain members, not admins; the admin persona is used only for the all_keys leg); `hydration-race` (every list and dialog verdict was read after the network settled and after a screenshot confirmed the surface rendered).

## Derived item verdict

`identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle` r2: **pass** (6 of 6 clauses).

Notes, not defects of this item:
- The first API attempt sent no `Origin` header from `127.0.0.1` and Better Auth refused sign-in 403 `INVALID_ORIGIN`; with `Origin: http://localhost:41873` every call went through. That was the driver, not the product.
- Checklist accuracy (not a fail of this run): the item's `source` row for `sys-api-key.object.ts` says `apiMethods ['get','list']`; the object declares `['get', 'list', 'update']` (update is what the revoke/restore PATCH rides). Handed to the dispatching seat, not extracted.

Timing: environment about 17 minutes (`pnpm build` 8m42s and `pnpm objectui:build` 8m07s under the verify lock), legs about 4 minutes.

Nothing is extracted from this record.
